title: Per-repo licence records
description: One record per reference repo, split by artifact kind because a repo's code and its prose are under different licences. The derived fields appear here so that a hand-written value can be contradicted by the derivation table rather than merely ignored -- the schema says the field exists, and the `licenses` check says what it must equal.

licenceValue.description: Licence values only, ordered least to most restrictive by the published order. A status is never a value: three of these five share the status `reusable`, so an order over statuses could not rank them.

contact.description: Recorded whether or not contact was made, which is why `not_attempted` is a value rather than an absent block.

attempted_on.description: Null when nothing happened. There is no date on which nothing happened, and the check refuses one.

license_file.description: Null means no licence file was found, and null is therefore `no_licence` whatever the README claims.

obligations.description: The union for this repo's code licence. Per-row obligations are a union again, over the sources a row cites.

readme_licence_claim.description: A README's claim is recorded because it is evidence, not because it is a grant.

licence_claim_discrepancy.description: Required alongside a claim that the licence file does not support: a claim with no recorded discrepancy is a claim someone will later read as settled.
